workspace.text:

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

**Thursday:** 10:00-10:30 - Elena busy (Hiring panel). **14:30-15:00 - ALL FOUR FREE.** ✅

Please go ahead and create the booking for Thursday at 14:30. I'll send the confirmation email once you confirm the booking is made.
